title: The customer cross-account role can escalate to admin and trusts the whole Anthus account
description:
infra/customer-role.yml:164-182 allows iam:CreateRole, iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy and iam:PassRole on roles named ChatticusComputers* with no permissions boundary and no allow-list of attachable policies, next to ecs:RunTask and ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition on *. Whoever assumes the role can create an admin role and run a task as it. The trust (lines 39-48) is the Anthus account root with the organization id as ExternalId, and control-plane-stack.ts:318-323 and 397-401 grant sts:AssumeRole on arn:aws:iam::*:role/ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole in any account. infra/test/customer-role-template.test.ts:31-58 checks the action list only.

Fix: ship a ChatticusComputersBoundary managed policy in the template and require it with an iam:PermissionsBoundary condition on CreateRole/PutRolePolicy/AttachRolePolicy; allow-list iam:PolicyARN; scope ECS actions by cluster and task-definition family as infra/lib/computer-host-start.ts:412-432 does; trust the exact FrontDoor and ComputerStarter role ARNs instead of :root; generate a random per-organization ExternalId at provisioning and store it on the organization record; resolve the target account only from that record. Tests in infra/test and Gherkin for the ExternalId behavior.
